description: Definitions for B2B properties relating to SSO setup and usage by Admins

email_domain_error.description: During Nitro SSO setup: if there is an error during email domain validation, indicate which one

email_domain_submitted_count.description: Number of email domains submitted for validation so far by the Admin (Nitro SSO)

email_domain_validated_count.description: Number of email domains successfully validated so far (Nitro SSO)

encryption_service_platform_selected.description: Encryption service selected for SSO (Azure or AWS for Self-hosted SSO, AWS for Nitro SSO)

sso_setup_step.description: The step which the admin is either on Nitro SSO or Self-Hosted SSO setup

sso_solution_chosen.description: Admin chooses between Nitro SSO and Self Hosted SSO at the start of the funnel

test_sso_response.description: Response from the optional SSO testing (Step 5, Nitro SSO)
